name: create-empty-metadata-rejection
title: Reject empty title and description at task.py create
description: task.py create writes records the downstream pre-archive gates refuse: an empty description is only a stderr warning (task_store.py line ~353) and a whitespace title passes the truthiness test when --slug bypasses slug derivation; make create exit nonzero before ensure_tasks_dir with an explicitly stated whitespace predicate so Python and JS validators agree on U+FEFF and U+0085; observed blocking sd-ai-command-pack PR #376 finalization hours after creation.
creator: sdelmas
